SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS beverage_revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE LOWER(p.product_type) = 'beverage'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
LIMIT 500
